_readme: TUNED SETTINGS for Hindi-medium math on a CPU laptop (v6.3.0). Do NOT replace your config.json with this file — open YOUR config.json (written by setup_credentials.py / start_all.py; generated on your machine, never shipped) and add ONLY the 'listener' section below next to your token/class_id/lesson_id. v6.3.0: prefer PRESETS per lesson — 'preset': 'math_en' (English math pilot; HARD English lock, hi model never loaded) or 'hindi_class' (Hindi-medium; hi pinned, EN probes skipped) or the CLI --preset; 'auto' keeps the measured router. Defaults stay: model_size 'small-hi' (stock small for EN + Hindi fine-tune for HI, language router with script sanity), beam_size 1, cpu_threads 0, block_ms 200, max_utt_s 12 with word-gap cuts, hotwords OFF (measured: 3-9x slower, destabilizes both models), without_timestamps true, vad_filter true, merge_max_s 25 (no-drop backlog merger), carry_prompt_words 8 (continuation), cap_gap_frames 3, probe_every 3, adaptive_max_utt true (watchdog shortens chunks when RTF>1), soft_retry true (ONE budget-gated re-decode per fully-dropped utterance), stitch_tail_words 6 + stitch_window_s 12 (math tail rescue: 'one half is greater than' + 'three quarters.' ships as ONE claim), math_initial_prompt false, hindi_classroom_prompt false (prompts are opt-in per class; never cross routes), hi_model null / en_model null (default Hindi/English models; local overrides only after docs/FINETUNE_HI_OPTIONAL.md). You normally need NO listener section at all. Measure your room: python mic_listener.py --bench saved_audio/utt_*.wav --ref "exact words" (fixtures: bench_fixtures/)

listener.initial_prompt: Class 4-5 math lesson: fractions, one half, three quarters, numerator, denominator, greater than, less than, equals
